gatewright.desc: Halvard Rimegate (gatewright, 1x): calm; slate wool tunic under a leather jerkin, belted grey trousers, short grey beard, ash mantle.

frostspeaker.desc: Gudrun Hoarwick (frost-speaker, 1x): grey wool tunic, belted slate trousers, long pale braid to the waist, rune cuffs (blue glow = fx).

veyra.desc: Veyra Ashmantle (the Rift-Warden before the rime-plate, 1.2x): violet-black long coat worn open over a pale tunic + belt, belted trousers, ash-grey mantle, small belt lantern. Before the rime-plate.

eira.desc: Eira (Veyra's sister, memory, 1x): pale belted tunic, belted trousers, hand lantern; glowing-outline = fx (eira_outline), shown only in memories.

nf_trader.desc: Tove Lanternwright (trader, 1x): layered tunics (slate under sand), wide belt hung with pouches, knit cap look via short hair.

elkman.desc: Ketil Icehook (elk-keeper, 1x): quilted leather jerkin over a grey tunic, rope-belted trousers, short beard, crook.

archivist.desc: Vigdis Stillwater (archivist, 1x): ink-stained wrap tunic, belted trousers, hair in a bun.

brisa.desc: Warden-Captain Brisa Rimeheart (guard captain NPC, 1x; same look as the 3x mini-boss): leather jerkin over a grey-blue belted tunic, belted trousers, small frost shield.
